import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

quotes_data = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv', parse_dates=['date'])

# Read the corporate actions data
corporate_actions_data = pd.read_csv('corporate_actions.csv', parse_dates=['date'])

# Filter the quotes data for the last 10 sessions
last_date = quotes_data['date'].max()
last_10_sessions = quotes_data[quotes_data['date'] >= last_date - pd.Timedelta(days=10)]

# Calculate daily returns
daily_returns = last_10_sessions.groupby('ticker')['close'].pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate mean returns and standard deviations
mean_returns = daily_returns.mean()
std_devs = daily_returns.std()

# Calculate the Sharpe ratio for each ticker
sharpe_ratios = (mean_returns - risk_free_rate) / std_devs

# Normalize the Sharpe ratios to get the weights
weights = sharpe_ratios / sharpe_ratios.sum()

# Convert the weights to a dictionary
weights_dict = weights.to_dict()

# Print the weights
print(weights_dict)

submit(weights_dict)
```
